infeasible_or_dropped: STEP 1 DROPPED: spec section 7 and owner decision #2 ('correct common_password_spray T1110.004 to T1110.003'). Wrong. contracts/rules/common_password_spray.yml:12-19 and CHANGELOG.md:890 record a deliberate 2026-08-26 re-tag to T1110.004 (credential stuffing). True password spraying is documented as an uncovered gap. Replacement: Splunk T1110.003 datasets can score HIT_FAMILY at best through the T1110 brute-force rules and are listed as 'no exact rule'. No contract edit. The product-scope question 'add a one-source-many-accounts spray rule' is an owner decision.

STEP 1 FIXED, not dropped: oracle_agrees_no_fire may be computed only for Windows Security/Sysmon XML datasets whose family contains one of the 6 ORACLE_RULES ids. Everything else gets oracle:'not_applicable'. The rule-index filter is (mitre.framework or 'attack')=='attack', which keeps the 26 framework-less enterprise rules and skips atlas / attack-ics / agent_tool_call_burst. Add an UNLABELLED bucket and a PARTIAL_PARSE flag (parsed_fraction). The unit is one YAML scenario with its files merged, asserted sum(buckets)==scenarios fetched. The label also records the directory name as a cross-check, which is the only label for the 225 old-style YAMLs. --require-corpus needs at least 1 dataset in the scoreable bucket (parser and rule) or rc=1, plus control N9. Pinning uses `git fetch --depth 1 origin <sha>` then checkout. The NOT_FETCHED versus failed-LFS distinction must be logged. A control is required for every adapter that ships, so the first merge is the Windows XML Splunk adapter plus EVTX-to-MITRE only (about 22 h). linux_secure, CloudTrail, k8s and OTRF adapters are deferred until each has a fixture-based positive control. python-evtx is lazy-imported so the blocking test passes without it. The EVTX-to-MITRE size and file-count claims are removed from the manifest until the first fetch. Non-technique top-level folders (Antivirus, EVTX_full_APT_attack_steps) map to UNLABELLED.

STEP 1 INFEASIBLE WITHOUT OWNER: Tier 0, the vendored third-party subset in the blocking gate. It needs the owner decision on vendoring, licence sign-off and the new THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES file (the repo has only LICENSE). Until then the blocking lane holds only the synthetic-control test, which proves the instrument but is not a third-party measurement; SSOT must say exactly that. EVTX-ATTACK-SAMPLES (GPL-3.0) is never vendored.

STEP 2 DROPPED: claim that adapter completion may change existing infra_takeover numbers or that the k8s requestReceivedTimestamp rewrite affects it. The existing builders use none of cef/db_audit/sysmon/opcua/inventory sources, and the k8s payload has no such field. The 'report as a correction' branch is removed. Add the k8s rewrite only if a new supply_chain payload carries the field.

STEP 2 REPLACED: pacing/jitter_pct_50 and the analytic 'CV=j/sqrt(3), evades above 0.433' prediction. Per-timestamp jitter doubles the interval variance, and the engine evaluates sample CV over prefixes of 6 to 8 events, so ±50% still fires about 17% of the time. Use ±100% of the period (about 2% residual), or measure the boundary by bisection. 'Three new variants' is corrected to four (to_business_hours, to_night, jitter, hostname_rotate_all). hostname_rotate_all needs new get/set_hostname adapters.

STEP 2 MARKED searched:false: common_beaconing c2_beacon on the evasion_search loss axis. Thinning leaves a 120 s gap and sample CV of about 0.31 or more, so measured tolerated loss is 0 while _predict says 2. Mark searched:false with reason 'periodic rule' or add a periodicity-aware model before wiring. Wire evasion_search over the new storylines only after one clean run.

STEP 2 FIXED: insider_exfil's common_beaconing must_not_fire control needs 6 or more irregular sysmon-3 events (CV above 0.25) paired with the 6 regular positive. With 4 events it can never test periodicity. Split cloud_iam_abuse.iam_persistence per technique (CreateAccessKey T1098.001, AttachUserPolicy T1098.003, CreateUser T1136.003) and verify every ATT&CK id against v14 and the ICS ids already in use. impossible_travel steps (phishing_bec.foreign_login, cloud_iam_abuse.attacker_console_login) need their victim_session events pulled into evasion_search._detects and verify_subset_equivalence, or test_scenario_harness.py:340 goes red. phishing_bec staggering must keep first-alert times monotone in expected_sequence order. All nine oracles use ONE incident_count convention (the number of full-chain incidents WS-8 really produces; it_intrusion's aspirational 1 stays a flagged known membership_ok=False).

STEP 2 SCOPE ADDITIONS: ScenarioDef.negatives needs a named consumer (scenario_matrix or oracle_consistency) with the 'attribute restored' positive twin on the same builder path. Audit the loops in test_scenario_harness that assume 3 storylines. technique_matrix excludes loss/drop_<own step> and changed==0 variants from survive/evade cells. The artefact must record seed and the scenario list, and technique_matrix asserts seed==7 and set==reg.BY_NAME (eval/adversarial/out is gitignored). Revised 80 h.

STEP 3 REDUCED: Stage 3 (leading the report summary, finding string and trend viewer with causal_order_fidelity, relabelling chain_fidelity/FCR 'entity-bridge only') is owner-gated. Default deliverable: causal_order_fidelity and order_concordance reported as CO-metrics, with O explicitly labelled 'timestamp invariant, 1.0 by construction'. Stage 2 is justified only by DAG grading, the edge-time term and fcr_not_worse. order_retained already gates `pass` for reversals today, so the 'closes a hole' argument is dropped. Claim 'A is the product-sensitive edge term' is weakened: ai_to_ot has a single edge, so only O discriminates there. Claim 'baseline.json has no mutation_robustness' is corrected: it holds the key as null. grade_causal_order must take per-incident graphs (min ts_ms per pair), not the deduped union, and needs a typed-kind-winner test. Part (b) proposal options C and D remain out of scope.

STEP 4 INFEASIBLE AS WRITTEN, FIXED: (1) oracle_consistency's forbidden-edge channel is dead (reads edge['from_step']/['to_step'], which no graph carries). Fix it using grade['per_forbidden_pair'] with joined=True (5 pairs) and record a class entry in _ACCEPTED ('directional_discrimination=0.0'). The 'oracle_consistency byte-identical' acceptance is restricted to the stale-gap, decorative and unexpected counts. WEAKER mutants need a headline change or a named reconcile count change. STEP 5 FIXED: F5 'floods collapse to at most 2 alert ids' only holds for one group in 2 or fewer buckets. Report alerts_per_event_cost for multi-group/bucket floods, and hold asset exposure constant for the 'score unchanged' control. F1 noise is counted in counter HITS (a companion counts too), found by bisection on full-stream FastProbe replays, with the mandatory pause (above the shortest co-resident window) included in the cost vector. The evasion_search step-subset shortcut is invalid for this axis, and parity must be re-proven on a noise stream. The floor schema gets `open_finding: <id>`: a respelling_evades/forgery_evades false-floor is enforced only for rule-sets with no open BUG, and a stale finding forces the floor flip. Per-field better=min|max. The fingerprint also covers selection/not_in clauses and allowlist file sha256, and a suppression axis is added. The generated table in detection-coverage.md must not start with '| Rule |' (check_lane_coverage would union it into the scorecard), or it goes to a separate generated file. FastProbe refuses to cache wall-clock-derived times. impossible_travel is tagged production_reachable:false. The F1 backend is deque-only (Redis uses EXPIRE), with an optional Redis half. triage_rank and incident_inflation are new, informational metrics. ci.yml nightly --full lane deferred to the owner and step 6. Product fixes for F1/F2/F3 are out of scope. Revised 80 h.

'Retained' per technique also requires not in expected_rule_lost_steps (tactic_lost alone is satisfied by any same-tactic rule); the base cell is renamed tactic_covered with a separate expected_rule_fired cell. Define pinned semantics (any change is PINNED-CHANGED and needs a history entry with reason and evidence), or give chain_fidelity/FCR directions. fire_check freshness uses a sidecar fingerprint file. History moves to eval/twin/ratchet_history.jsonl with merge=union. Atom count is about 1000 and about 80 KB. Path typos fixed (eval/twin/oracle_consistency.py; negative_controls under report context). Revised 32 h.

STEP 7 FIXED: oracle reader uses detection_points[step].expected_rules as plain strings and gap.no_rule_exists nested. TPR denominators are computed from the oracle (5/5, 5/5, 3/3 today), not the '6/6' example. Credit a technique only if the rule actually fired at that step (subtract decorative_expectations), otherwise label the column 'declared by oracle'.
